stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS via College Navigator (fall 2024). JWU does not publish a Common Data Set that could be found (jwu.edu is behind a bot-protection page); the www.jwu.edu pages could not be read, so deadlines, test policy and requirements come from the JWU online catalog. College Navigator prints 7,828 applicants and 88% admitted (85% men, 90% women) but not the admit count, so admits is left null rather than back-computed; 16% of admitted students enrolled. Undergraduate enrollment is fall 2024 (3,908 of 4,303 total). International applicant counts, GPA, ED and residency splits are not available from this source. Applicant/admit/enrolled counts replaced with exact IPEDS ADM2023 (fall 2023) figures, because the newer source gives only a rounded admit rate.
